description: Dataset of Hydropower Plants and potential Run-of-River in Peru is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Leonardo Gutierrez. Development of Hydropower Plants (HPP) and potential Run-of-River (RoR) dataset over Peru, for historical variability 1981-01 to 2020-12, and climate change projections 2036 to 2065 (mid-term) and 2071 to 2100 (long-term). Coverage: national (PE); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 8276872 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is GPL 3.0+. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
